idea-plugin.name: Spring Data JPA Query Method Linter
idea-plugin.description:
Spring Data JPA Query Method Linter

Real-time validation, syntax typo detection, and instant SQL/JPQL preview for Spring Data JPA derived query methods.

Features

  • Real-time Typo Detection: Validates method property names against JPA @Entity fields.
  • Smart Suggestions & Quick Fix: 1-click Quick Fix (Alt+Enter / Ctrl+.) for typos in verbs, operators, sort directions, and properties.
  • SQL / JPQL Preview: Inspect generated JPQL and SQL queries directly on hover or Ctrl+Q.
  • Deep Traversal: Supports multi-level entity navigation (e.g. findByRoom_Building_Manager_Name).
  • 100% Offline: No cloud dependencies, zero external tokens, ultra-fast in-memory analysis.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.4.0: Smart Entity Resolution: automatic relation detection, @MappedSuperclass inheritance, deep recursive traversal, and accurate nested JPQL query preview.
  • 0.3.3: Comprehensive user documentation, Quick Start guide, and installation cheat sheet.
  • 0.3.2: Support entity subject descriptors (findDistinctInvoiceBy...), AllIgnoreCase suffix, dynamic projections (Class), PascalCase validation, and signature/return type validation.
  • 0.3.1: Support 'All' prefix modifier (findAllByOrderBy...), collection operators (IsEmpty/IsNotEmpty), and Spring 3.1+ Limit parameters.
  • 0.3.0: Added Quick Fix (Alt+Enter) support for query method errors and typos.
  • 0.2.3: Initial release with real-time derived query method validation and SQL hover preview.
